comment: A coronal mass ejection (CME) seen on 28-SEP associated with a filament lift off is expected to arrive in the second forecast period. Geomagnetic conditions are anticipated to be ACTIVE with chances of STORM G1 intervals. The effects from this CME are expected to gradually decline into the third period. Another CME associated with an C9-class flare was observed around 02:45UT on 30-Sep. Although further analysis is required, initial analyisis suggests the CME cloud will pass ahead of Earth's orbit.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
